_note: 152 queries: the original 20 conversational + 8 brand, then two later rounds of additions across sixteen classes (id prefixes conv_, outfit_, aud_, budget_, brand_, attr_, neg_, style_, lang_, trap_, typo_, short_, long_, fit_, gift_, acc_) so the harness can see audiences, budget shapes, negations, materials, styles, non-English, misspellings, very short and rambling asks, fit needs, gifts and look-alike traps. Slot rules follow one discipline, written against listing-title conventions before looking at any output: any = at least one term must appear in the title (whole words, plural tolerant), none = none may, all = one of these must (the brand). max_price/min_price mirror explicit dollar limits; budget_in_text marks that the number appears in the sentence.
